base: Frozen raw pruning125 OOF predictions, seed42 from113/110 and seed43/44 from116, selected branch affirmed by118. Baseline is original retained gap-only coefficients, not newly tuned.

definitions.prior_gap: log1p(D1-D2), where D2<D1<D are two latest distinct started days in frozen111 matrix for same horse_id. No ID stitching. Different from current D-D1 gap; missing neutral exponent offset.
definitions.global_temperature: x=log(p)-mean_horse(log(p)) within full started race; fit gap and x jointly on raw pruning125 p.
definitions.context_temperature: Joint gap + global x + x times one-hot field-size3/entropy3/top-gap3. fieldsize<=9,10-13,14+; entropy=-sum(p*log(p))/log(N); topgap=log(pmax/max(psecond,1e-12)). Entropy/topgap tertile boundaries from eligible strict-prior fit races only, unique quantile edges, np.digitize right=False. N=1 entropy=0, topgap=log(1/1e-12), x=0.
definitions.context_regularization: New diagonal-ridge specification: gap/global ridge1e-6, nine context slopes lambda1000/n_fit_races. Lambda1000 fixed from old diagnostic; no ridge search. Old context basis retained, not an exact replay of old uniform-ridge/grid procedure.

progression: Require complete all3 seeds and exact same ordered eligible race/day population. Advance A/B if mean3 seed per-race loss difference vs retained<0. Advance C only if mean differences vs both retained and B<0. No individual seed winner selection, no CI exclusion requirement, no formal RETAIN or ADOPT.
limitations: Historical development and selection-used full-information inputs; no unused confirmation/preweight proof.
Winner NLL only; top2/top3/ECE/recent/subgroup quality guards not measured. ADVANCE means next full-quality check, never adoption.
Race-day CI is conditional sampling only; gamma re-estimation and training noise not included. Mean3 seed losses are not a probability ensemble.
Prior-gap history is restricted to frozen matrix started rows and same IDs; missing histories/ID breaks stay missing, not repaired. Not exact reproduction of081 flat-race history.
Context slopes are linearly redundant with global temperature; ridge makes predictions identifiable but coefficients are not causally interpretable.
No booster training, DB refresh, production mutation, annual-budget reservation or outcome-adaptive retries.

temperature_domain.check: all prior fit and held races
temperature_domain.legacy_difference: Old diagnostic optimizer had no explicit positivity constraint. This new screen refuses nonpositive fitted/held exponents without retuning.
